rd.researchQuestion: Can Enter, Clear, Reset, PF1-PF24, and extensible named actions, plus semantic status and message regions, be presented natively without Forma owning their behavior?
rd.technicalUncertainty: Whether native submit buttons (default button, submitter, formnovalidate) and live regions express terminal action and status semantics without script, and keep non-color cues under forced colors.
